skill.title: Turn important reference unknowns into targeted, auditable research
skill.problem: An occluded view, missing dimension, or conflicting variant can silently become invented geometry when the agent gathers images broadly or treats every search result as equally authoritative.

exclusions: deferred high-impact uncertainty without a human decision

preconditions: the target and intended variant are explicitly identified
the uncertainty names a property that could affect modeling or evaluation
the current evidence does not already resolve the question
required_observations: why the current set cannot answer the question
the modeling impact if the answer is wrong
source identity and variant for every inspected candidate
the exact claim each accepted source is allowed to support
action_policy: Turn the unknown into one property-scoped question and one or more exact search queries.
Record inspected candidates even when rejected, including provenance, observed variant, and rejection reason.
Link accepted candidates to factual ReferenceItem records; never let an accepted conclusion float free of its source.
Keep high-impact questions open until accepted evidence or a human decision resolves them.
A lower-impact question may be deferred only with a concrete reversible modeling constraint and an evaluation exclusion.
Return to targeted research when modeling reveals a new important uncertainty.
expected_effects: clear separation between same-variant evidence and attractive but irrelevant results
a planner-visible stop condition when important evidence is still missing
cheap revision of explicitly deferred low-impact geometry
failure_predicates: a high-impact question remains open while blockout begins
an accepted candidate does not link to a reference item
a deferred question has no modeling constraint
a different variant silently authorizes target geometry
search quantity is reported as success without property coverage
recovery: reject or narrow the unsupported candidate
remove geometry that relied on the unsupported claim or keep it isolated and revisable

sources.description: Seven user-supplied reference-workflow videos converged on purpose-scoped sources, schema-visible missing evidence, and task-specific fidelity; all raw items remain separately bounded.
The artist assigns different secondary sources to specific facial, hair, and color properties rather than letting one source control the whole design.
The demonstrated visual wiki keeps stable evidence fields and direct source clips adjacent to claims.

runtime_usage.result: Resolved the official overall envelope, retained five rejected candidates, and bounded underside/revision uncertainty without authorizing modeling.

skill.version_scope: Reference policy is Blender-version independent; strict stage-gate behavior verified with Blender 5.2 LTS.
skill.status_note: Runtime validated for question-driven reference gating on one real product board. It is not transfer validated and has not yet demonstrated improved model fidelity in the pending equal-budget comparison.

skill.title: Gate modeling strategy on evidence-bound reference claims
skill.problem: A plausible prose description or silhouette can harden uncertain reference guesses into the wrong representation, component boundary, or depth structure before the model is cheap to revise.

applicability.workflow: reference-driven modeling before and during primary blockout
exclusions: automatic visual inference is not provided
weak or unknown claims cannot drive strategy booleans
policy success is not Blender or reference-fidelity proof

action_policy: Record each important interpretation as OBSERVED, STRONGLY_INFERRED, WEAKLY_INFERRED, or UNKNOWN.
Require concrete evidence for observed and strongly inferred claims.
Block blockout on high-impact weak/unknown claims or contradictory supported modeling signals.
Translate only observed/strongly inferred modeling signals into the strategy brief.
Keep weak areas reversible and preserve rejected construction strategies with reasons.
Verify the resulting Blender geometry and reference fidelity through separate truth channels.

evidence.scope: declared pure-Python policy cases across pendant-lamp and appliance-panel families
evidence.result: supported claims changed representation/component policy; weak claims were ignored; unknown/conflicting claims blocked modeling

skill.promotion_limit: Not TRANSFER_VALIDATED or RUNTIME_VALIDATED until real image interpretation changes Blender construction and improves measured outcomes on unrelated assets.

skill.title: Resolve component depth and continuity with a discriminating secondary view
skill.problem: A front view can make a continuous full-depth body and a narrow body with a separate full-front faceplate appear identical, causing an unsupported component boundary to harden into geometry.

applicability.reference_issue: primary-view ambiguity about component depth, continuity, or a separate faceplate
required_inputs: at least two explicit construction candidates
object and connected-component counts for built candidates
exclusions: material color boundaries without geometric depth evidence
articulated or separately manufactured parts whose boundary is independently observed

action_policy: Represent continuous and separate construction as explicit competing candidates.
If the primary-view scores are tied within the declared ambiguity tolerance, do not choose from that view.
Acquire a same-variant side, top, or oblique view that exposes depth or boundary continuation.
Require the selected strategy to clear both an absolute secondary-view fit gate and a predeclared margin over the alternative.
Verify CONTINUOUS_MESH as one object and one connected component; joining disconnected shells does not qualify.
Retain the rejected construction and its per-view measurements.
failure_predicates: only a primary/front view is available and candidates remain tied
a candidate lacks the required secondary view
secondary-view fit or margin is below the frozen threshold
the claimed continuous candidate contains multiple connected components
the reference variant differs across views
recovery: return TARGETED_REFERENCE_RESEARCH without a Blender mutation
search specifically for the missing same-variant depth-revealing view
keep the disputed region reversible until the evidence discriminates

evidence.result: both strategies score front IoU 1.0; top IoU rejects separate faceplates at 0.711577 and 0.695574 while continuous candidates remain 1.0
one-object/one-component continuous candidates and two-object/two-component controls reproduce all masks

skill.promotion_limit: Controlled synthetic two-family transfer only. Real photographic interpretation, a real prop decision through the typed transaction path, and measured fidelity improvement remain unproven.
